history.title: Our Story
history.text: From the mountains of Salento in the heart of Quindio, we brought our passion for artisan cuisine to Pereira. Every recipe carries the flavor of the Colombian countryside, prepared with fresh ingredients and the love of our coffee region.
history.originText: Rural Cocina Artesanal was born on the colorful streets of Salento, Quindio, in the heart of Colombia's Coffee Region. With Gustavo's dream of bringing authentic countryside flavors to more people, we moved to Pereira, to the Poblado 2 neighborhood, where today we continue cooking with the same passion and love for artisan food.
history.philosophyText: Every burger, every arepaburger, and every dish that comes out of our kitchen is prepared with fresh ingredients and artisan recipes. We don't take shortcuts. Our meat is 100% artisan, our pineapple is caramelized on the spot, and our sauces are homemade. We believe that good food is made with time, dedication, and a lot of heart.
history.todayText: Today Rural is more than a restaurant. It's a gathering place for families, friends, and food lovers in Pereira. With delivery across the city and an ever-growing menu, we stay true to our roots: artisan cuisine with a countryside soul. We welcome you Monday through Friday from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and Saturdays, Sundays and holidays from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
